facts.fact: Clara 在 2024 自己的 condo 硬地板上醒来——穿镜回家成功但晕过去了；déjà vu 让记忆归位：1901 的三天。
facts.anchor: Three days in 1901 with Ben. Trying to come home.

facts.fact: 说话的 Ben 用词现代（freaky）——2024 版 Ben；1901 版绝不会这么说。
facts.anchor: It sounds like Ben’s voice speaking, but the rhythm and the words are off. He’d never say “freaky.”

facts.fact: 镜子按便条要求被送回 1F——Ben 的私奔便条伏笔回收。
facts.anchor: “I asked Mrs. Guthrie and William in my note to make sure it was returned, to this unit specifically.”

facts.fact: 手机里有冒名对话：有人用她的口吻回复 Morgan「忙工作、外地做几天研究项目」。
facts.anchor: I—or more correctly someone writing as me—replied later that day. Busy with work. Out of town for a few days on a research project.

facts.fact: 假对话与她和 Morgan 的真实相处模式惊人相似（两人常因工作错身而过）。
facts.anchor: The conversation is so eerily similar to ones Morgan and I have had before that I shudder.

facts.fact: Ben 编失踪故事：跟朋友去 L.A.、忘带手机、摔跤失忆；朋友嗑药不记得，再花钱请人作证。
facts.anchor: I went to … L.A. with a friend, forgot my phone, and lost my memory.

facts.fact: 章末 Ben 扶住她的肩承诺：一切都会没事。
facts.anchor: He takes me by the shoulders. “Everything is going to be fine. I promise.”
